official_native.purpose: Check the official input-to-algorithm-to-metric loop without claiming GRAM comparability.
official_native.project_test_policy: No GRAM Toys/Beauty test file may be read. Official-repository test data must be labelled separately.

gram_port.purpose: Compare intervention location under the frozen GRAM cold50 validation protocol.
gram_port.allowed_split: Toys_cold50 validation; Beauty only after the Toys gate
gram_port.metric_scope: strict item-level evaluator with collision hard-fail
gram_port.project_test_policy: GRAM test is sealed; test_read must remain false
gram_port.code_reuse_policy: Because neither target repository contains a license file, do not copy or redistribute third-party implementation code. Implement adapters against the published mechanism and local contracts.

sources.name: SpecGR
sources.native_environment: phase15-specgr-native (Python 3.10; repository requirements isolated from gram-repro)
sources.gate_reason: Source is present, but the advertised Video Games dataset, semantic IDs, and SpecGR checkpoints are absent from HEAD and repository history.

compatibility_assertions.finding: CLI eval_mode is ignored at the final call and test is forced. A validation-only wrapper is mandatory before any project data is connected.
Checkpoint loading is hard-coded to cuda:0. Device-safe path adaptation is required for a local native run.
Official IDs are fixed-width RQ-VAE codes; GRAM paths are variable-length lexical paths and require a new path contract.
Quick start requests four GPUs and cannot be used as-is under the project resource policy.

sources.name: GenRecEdit
sources.native_environment: phase15-genrecedit-native (Python 3.10; CUDA 12.4 dependency stack isolated from gram-repro)
sources.gate_reason: Algorithm source and official LFS pointers exist. A minimal Video Games native run is actionable after selective LFS materialization and processed-cache construction; no full-model download is required.

compatibility_assertions.finding: The training script calls absent main.py; rec_main.py is the apparent repository entrypoint. Any path-only correction must be logged as an entry bug fix.
Probability probing hard-codes a 256-token codebook per SID position and cannot be applied directly to GRAM lexical paths.
The native method assumes four SID positions; GRAM needs explicit variable-length position/EOS/padding behavior.
Model placement defaults to the current CUDA device and needs a resource-policy wrapper.
The compact native evaluator matches a three-position SID prefix; it is not the project strict item-level evaluator.
The official cold split is derived from its test data. Native results must stay separate and this path is forbidden for the GRAM port.

sources.name: ColdGenRec
sources.retrieval_note: Paper-provided 4open.science endpoint redirects to an API that returned HTTP 401 on 2026-08-21. The guessed GitHub mirror github.com/zhangzhen-research/ColdGenrec returned repository not found.
sources.gate_reason: Reference source is not locally obtainable from the paper endpoint in the current environment. This does not block either target baseline. The paper remains the protocol reference.
